text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't know why, but my head's been hurting non-stop lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Maybe you've been studying party-people slang a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In my case, I'm trying way too hard to memorize it consciously.
I bet that's just putting extra strain on my brain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe talking to a mature person who isn't a party animal would neutralize it.
Like Maruzen-san, for example."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...No, but Maruzen-san
often uses strange words, too, doesn't she...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what 'chobeliba' means...
Oww, thinking about it is giving me a headache again...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Palmer was plagued by a headache for a while.
